entities.name: preemption
entities.description: Legal authority or regulation that overrides local laws or regulations, often related to land use and zoning.

entities.name: use
entities.description: Designated purpose or activity permitted on a property, such as residential, commercial, or mixed-use.

entities.name: density
entities.description: The measure of development intensity, often expressed as units per acre or square mile, within a specified area.

entities.name: height
entities.description: Maximum allowable height of structures within a designated zone or area, often subject to zoning codes.

entities.name: mixed-use districts
entities.description: Zones that allow a combination of residential, commercial, and sometimes industrial uses within the same area.

entities.name: parking reduction
entities.description: Legislation or policy allowing reduced parking requirements for developments, often near transit stops.

entities.name: major transit stop
entities.description: Significant public transportation hub, such as a metro station or intersection of high-frequency bus or trolley routes.

entities.name: urban areas
entities.description: Regions characterized by high density development, infrastructure, and population, including city centers and neighborhoods.

entities.name: bus system
entities.description: Public bus network providing transit services across various routes within the city.

entities.name: trolley stops
entities.description: Designated points where trolley vehicles pick up and drop off passengers, often integrated with bus routes.

entities.name: compatibility
entities.description: The degree to which new developments or policies are harmonious with existing neighborhood characteristics and infrastructure.
